name: POV: Your Life As…
description: Second-person life-path explainers that place the viewer inside a role, rank, or occupation and carry them through recruitment, daily routine, hierarchy, danger, rewards, advancement, failure, and likely ending.
tagline: Live the whole ladder from inside the role.
exampleTopics: POV: Your Life in Every Tier of Law Enforcement
POV: Your Life in Every Tier of a Criminal Empire
POV: Your Life as an Executioner in the Middle Ages
POV: Your Life as a Roman Vigile
POV: Your Life as a Pirate Quartermaster
audienceHint: Viewers who enjoy immersive history, hierarchy explainers, career ladders, and second-person documentary storytelling.
scriptContext: Address the viewer as 'you'. Move chronologically through entry, training, daily work, rank, danger, rewards, and ending. Make each tier materially different in authority, routine, incentives, and risk. Avoid game-stat language and empty cinematic roleplay; explain the real system from the inside.
scriptSystemPromptRole: You are an evidence-led documentary writer specializing in immersive second-person life histories and institutional hierarchies.
ideaSystemPromptRole: You design concrete second-person episode concepts where the viewer experiences a full role, hierarchy, or occupation from entry to exit.
ideaGuidanceText: Every concept must promise a full lived system, not a costume tour. Titles should use 'POV: Your Life…' or a close second-person equivalent and name a concrete role or tiered institution.
titleShapeRules: Prefer 'POV: Your Life as [specific role]' for one occupation.
Prefer 'POV: Your Life in Every Tier of [specific institution]' for a rank ladder.
Name the place or period when the role changes materially across contexts.
